80358.subject: [Action Advised] Manage your unused OAuth clients and protect your information
80358.body:
Your projects have inactive OAuth clients that are subject to automatic  
deletion.

Hello Google Developer,

In accordance with  
<https://c.gle/AAuDWvlhMpSX0A7q4tzvT3DtQP4PRgBhCx6m3bhOzG_sSRYjCAVbpHlF9d7J7zPUDQ5w5pSEUvg39p6imyXmV5yv8dKdxuuti27oY2oSFo9ZkC00vjienD4oLgzhsjvuPAF5UJM38a1XSA8oEPb4i7GMjtoYIuRmkXCJvgnOyV1_OvLdPrGLuOY>OAuth  
2.0 Policies , the following projects that you manage have OAuth clients  
that have been inactive for at least 5 months, and will be deleted in 30  
days unless you take action:


<https://c.gle/AAuDWvkcptqXL9rHqi0FQCTxifGx4Z7NrYqnjbwmsAtbB88cYMO61ZPqjj6Mbjxegp7E2siNIka27CiZb5zt-G_HIqBj3ex2cNGG1cmC9xf63RjdYUFTGCmqAlNqRP5EUmo_dO7O005arWWCDlVAHwtssejVtoG7g-BKu2newqJUo_tLo1T8V-bNXiRKot7PSBOivw>project-131c8270-1753-491a-9cc


Visit the  
<https://c.gle/AAuDWvlaZwYsbbVXQ8nMJpYh7htZES8CT2bDbFxQfUotRbXsLjn_miLvGXy-XBKOyMfb1UdYeU6nKbC9Um2eNsCN7vnIa3YtfbDozJddUPT4EbRpZ2G4gAyzfK2cbao>Google

Google LLC 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043

80357.subject: 🔷 The Daily: A WINK at Zcash
80357.body:
Winklevoss group seeks to launch Zcash ETF | Ondo to launch onchain private-company exposure | Spiko raises $90 million | Conduit sues Tether over $2.76 million freeze | ZachXBT says he fronted $349,700 to infiltrate alleged Chinese launderers

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by Yogita Khatri | Edited by Kyle Baird

Presented By:

( https://polymarket.us/?deep_link_sub1=THEBLOCK&c=NEWSLETTER&shortlink=94gey3fp&source_caller=api_v2&onelink_id=S8ac&pid=THEBLOCK&deep_link_value=midterms&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Tuesday! *Bitcoin* is holding steady at around *$85,600*.

In today's newsletter, the *Winklevoss* group seeks to launch a *Zcash* ETF under the proposed *WINK* ticker, *Ondo* launches onchain exposure to private companies, *Spiko* raises *$90 million* to expand its tokenized cash funds, and more.

Meanwhile, *Fortitude* expands ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-06-fortitude-expands-zcash-mining-push-with-up-to-100-million-equipment-commitment-417790?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) its *Zcash* mining push with up to a *$100 million* equipment commitment, and *Polymarket* rolls out ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-06-polymarket-rolls-out-v2-upgrade-with-single-erc-1155-positions-contract-pusd-collateral-417804?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) its V2 upgrade.

P.S. Don't forget to check out The Latent ( https://thelatent.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) , our sister website covering AI. Get The Latent Daily here ( https://thelatent.co/newsletter?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) and all other The Block newsletters here ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ).

*THE BIG ONE*

*😉 Winklevoss group seeks to launch Zcash ETF with 0.25% fee, WINK ticker*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-10-06-winklevoss-files-spot-zcash-etf-wink-417826?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*Winklevoss Asset Services* has filed with the SEC to launch a *spot Zcash ETF* that would hold ZEC directly and list on Nasdaq under the proposed ticker *WINK*.

* *Gemini Trust Company* would serve as custodian, with the fund charging a *0.25% annual sponsor fee*.
* *Winklevoss Capital Fund* has indicated nonbinding interest in purchasing *up to $100 million* of shares in the proposed ETF.
* *Cypherpunk Technologies* would serve as the fund's Zcash ecosystem partner, assisting with areas including protocol development and coinholder polling.
* The filing makes Winklevoss Asset Services the *third issuer* to pursue a U.S. spot Zcash ETF, after *Grayscale* and *Bitwise*.
